description: Fetch a single Reddit post by its id. Returns the full post object (title, author, score, text, permalink, subreddit, url). Use when you already have a post id and want its details. Example: id='abc123' (the base-36 id, no t3_ prefix).

id.description: The post's base-36 id (e.g. 'abc123'), without the 't3_' fullname prefix. Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_post
